attempts.sql: WITH cg AS (SELECT symbol_id, file_id FROM code.symbols WHERE name = 'create_graph' AND file_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py'), args AS (SELECT c.call_id, c.callee_name, c.line FROM code.calls c JOIN cg ON c.caller_symbol_id = cg.symbol_id), plain AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.callee_name FROM args a WHERE a.callee_name ~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.symbols s WHERE s.file_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py' AND s.name = a.callee_name AND s.kind IN ('function','method') AND s.line_start = a.line)) SELECT DISTINCT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN plain p ON s.name = p.callee_name WHERE s.kind IN ('function','method') ORDER BY s.symbol_id

request:
When the text-to-SQL LangGraph is assembled by create_graph in auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py, which functions or methods of this repository does create_graph hand over by reference, i.e. pass the function object itself as an argument to another call (as with graph.add_conditional_edges(node, router_fn, ...)) rather than calling it? Count only plain names passed directly as call arguments; functions that create_graph calls itself, values that are the result of a call (such as _make_soft_check_router(...)), lambdas, and local variables holding nodes do not count. Functions passed only inside an if/else branch of create_graph count. Return each distinct function's symbol ID.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds create_graph in the text-to-sql graph module, collects the callee names it references, keeps only plain identifier names (excluding lambdas and call results), and resolves them to repository function/method symbols. Returns each distinct matching symbol ID.
